summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of the Airbnb-style /stays discovery+booking flow for BDS Marvel. Backend auth (register/login/me/refresh/logout), stays booking creation (instant/request), overlap 409, past-date 422, capacity 422, bookings/mine, bookings/{id}, availability, and legacy /bookings all pass. Frontend /stays home, where-panel autoopen, calendar, who counters, search navigation to results (with map, count, cards, price per nights), stay detail (gallery, blocked dates for 11-12 Nov from confirmed booking, booking-panel error without dates), checkout multi-step (edit dates/guests modals, register, phone, agree, submit) with instant mode producing a successful confirmed trip page (BDS-5F356C) all work. Mobile (390px) search pill, sheet, mobile-booking-bar + sheet all present.

minor.issue: Known: email sending fails with 401 (EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY) - booking still saved. Logged as 'Stay booking saved but email notification failed'.

ui_bugs.issue: URL query params checkin/checkout/adults/children/infants/pets/mode are NOT pre-populated into the checkout state on load. Only mode is honored (via checkout-mode-* tabs). User lands on checkout from detail with ?checkin=&checkout=&adults=... and the Dates/Guests both show 'Not selected' + 'Choose your check-in and checkout dates.' / 'Add at least one adult.' This breaks the stated requirement 'navigate to /stays/book/<slug>?mode=...  preserving dates/guests' and forces guest to re-enter.
ui_bugs.selector: /stays/book/<slug>?checkin=...&checkout=...&adults=... -> summary-dates and checkout-guests should reflect query params

issues: Leaflet map tiles render blank/light grey in results map (stays-map); only price pins visible. Likely Google tile URL loading issue or CORS/CSP; detail-map on StayDetail renders similarly minimal. Pins are shown but tiles missing hurts the discovery UX.

action_items: Checkout.jsx: On mount, parse URL query params (checkin, checkout, adults, children, infants, pets) and seed draft/sessionStorage so the trip step shows the dates/guests and price breakdown without user editing again. Spec explicitly requires this.

Investigate why Leaflet tiles render blank on stays-map (and detail-map). Verify tile URL template reaches browser (e.g., https://mt{s}.google.com/vt/lyrs=m&... ) and is not blocked by CSP; add an OSM fallback.

(Low) The google sign-in button is a <button> element without an href; verify it navigates to https://auth.emergentagent.com/?redirect=<current checkout url> on click. Automated test only verified it renders; manual verification suggested.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_current_user: fine but 'bearer' is tried as session first then jwt; both lookups run which costs 2 DB calls on every authed request when using Authorization header. Minor perf.
server.py JWT_SECRET read at import time via os.environ[...] - will crash on missing env; acceptable but prefer explicit startup validation.
_confirmed_overlap uses lexicographic string comparison on YYYY-MM-DD which is correct, but relies on consistent date format; a comment or parse-to-date would be safer.
Checkout.jsx should honor incoming URL query params (checkin/checkout/adults/...) - clear bug vs spec.

success_rate.backend: 95% (17/18 passed; 1 was a test-side fixture scoping issue under pytest-xdist, not a backend bug; 1 availability assertion fixed is a test-side issue - endpoint returns {booked, requested} dict which is actually what frontend consumes)
success_rate.frontend: 90% (all testids and flows working; one spec deviation - URL params not pre-populated in checkout; map tiles blank)

rca_of_the_issue: Checkout.jsx does not read query string on mount; the search pill navigates to /stays/search?... which StaysSearch does parse, but the detail 'Book this stay' / 'Request a night' buttons link to /stays/book/<slug>?mode=...&checkin=...&checkout=...&adults=... and Checkout only reads sessionStorage draft or default empty state. Fix: in Checkout.jsx initial state effect, parse useSearchParams for checkin/checkout/adults/children/infants/pets and merge into draft (also persist to sessionStorage) before rendering.
